title: Aurora Archives: a nightly low-latitude aurora index from US newspapers (1800-1963) and a catalogue of pre-1868 geomagnetic storms
description: Nightly index of aurora sightings from 326,123 US newspaper articles (1800-1963, American Stories corpus), validated against the aaH (1868-1950) and Helsinki Ak (1844-1867) magnetometer records, and a catalogue of 49 confirmed pre-1868 storms with article-level evidence. Includes code, agent prompts, 3,091 agent labels, independent blind re-labelling, the classifier and all dossiers. Code MIT, derived data CC BY 4.0.
